meta.title: The Brunch Break — Brunch, Fit Bakery & Coffee in Arrecife, Lanzarote
meta.description: The Brunch Break is a brunch café in Arrecife, Lanzarote. Artisan bakery, specialty coffee and fit dishes in a space designed to pause your day. Book or order to go.

hero.subtitle: Artisan bakery, specialty coffee and fit dishes in the heart of Arrecife. A place to pause your day, slowly.

story.title: We started with a simple idea
paragraphs: The Brunch Break was born in Arrecife with one obsession: turning brunch into a ritual, not a rush. Every table is a pause; every dish, a reason to stay a little longer.

From the first coffee to the last cake in our display case, everything is thought through and baked with the same care: real ingredients, our own recipes, and a warm space where time moves differently.
story.founderRole: Creator of concepts, brands and experiences

philosophy.title: Eating well, without giving up pleasure
philosophy.intro: Fit doesn't mean bland. Our kitchen balances real ingredients, bakery technique and a touch of indulgence that never apologizes.

pillars.title: Real ingredients
pillars.description: Fresh produce, from local suppliers whenever possible, with no shortcuts or ultra-processed food.

pillars.title: Baked in-house
pillars.description: Artisan bakery from early morning: fermented doughs, cakes and pastries fresh out of our own oven.

pillars.title: Fit balance
pillars.description: Dishes designed to make you feel good: protein, fiber and flavor, without sacrificing either.

pillars.title: A ritual of pause
pillars.description: A space designed to disconnect: natural light, plants, and time to enjoy without watching the clock.
